title: OLA Python client close callback
problem: Python ClientWrapper does not expose OlaClient's socket close callback, preventing applications from reacting cleanly when olad restarts.
reproduce: Construct ClientWrapper with close_callback; the unpatched constructor rejects the keyword argument before the client can run.
acceptance: ClientWrapper accepts and forwards close_callback, socket closure is idempotent, and the callback runs at most once.
repair: Add the close_callback argument to ClientWrapper, forward it to OlaClient, and consume the callback during the first safe socket teardown.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the production ClientWrapper constructor through a controlled OlaClient seam and verifies source contracts for idempotent teardown. Six upstream Python tests passed separately with generated protobuf bindings; this offline case does not run a live olad daemon restart.
verification.ownerCheck: Start a Python application with ClientWrapper(close_callback=...), restart olad, and confirm the callback runs once without an uncaught exception. Reconnect or stop from the callback, then record OLA revision, Python version and daemon logs.
